name: Generiek (wettelijk minimum)
sector: Alle sectoren zonder eigen CAO (wettelijke bodem)

payScales.source: lib/Standards/tables/nl-2026.json parameters.wml.referentiemaandloon (RPP2026 bijlage 3) — the statutory minimum-wage reference monthly wage. Already verified:true in the engine's own tax-table corpus; re-cited here (not re-derived) so cao-generiek is the verified anchor that proves the below-CAO-minimum check path end-to-end (design.md Seed Data).

allowances.source: No statutory allowance floor beyond the minimum wage itself; sector CAOs (cao-metaal-techniek, cao-horeca) name their own.

leaveEntitlement.source: BW art. 7:634 — statutory annual leave is at least 4x the contractual weekly working time; 20 days is the reference count at an 8-hour day, 5-day, 40-hour full-time week (4 x 40 / 8 = 20). CaoRegistry::minLeaveHours() prorates this by the contract's actual weekly hours (documented 5-day-week assumption, design.md D2/Risks) rather than assuming a 40-hour week.

workingTime.source: Informational reference full-time week; no statutory maximum norm week is fixed by NL law. Display-only — not read by any CaoRegistry resolver.

overtime.source: Illustrative overwerktoeslag percentages (Generiek) pending confirmation against the official CAO-tekst — NOT transcribed from the primary document. Placeholder, so CaoRegistry::overtimeToeslagPercentages() resolves to null and no overtime uplift is derived from this CAO until the figures are confirmed.
overtime.checkAgainst: Geen bron — generieke fallback zonder CAO-specifieke overwerkregeling
